query:
SELECT ct.id, ct.identifier, ct.totalVias, ct.ctoId,
  COUNT(cv.id) as via_count,
  MIN(cv.viaNumber) as min_via_number,
  MAX(cv.viaNumber) as max_via_number
FROM cto_tubes ct
LEFT JOIN cto_vias cv ON cv.tubeId = ct.id
WHERE ct.cto_tube_type = 'splitter'
GROUP BY ct.id, ct.identifier, ct.totalVias, ct.ctoId
ORDER BY ct.id;
